Title: Bagged lettuce: 3 weeks at 32°F, 5–10 days at 41°F
Description: Greens keep best at 32–34°F in high humidity. Bagged lettuce lasts about 3 weeks at 32°F but 5–10 days at 41°F. Diagnose limp, slimy, or rusty greens.
Keywords: food storage, kitchen tips, reduce food waste, produce storage, meal planning

Title: Popping water heater? Sediment, and a yearly flush
Description: Popping usually means sediment is trapping steam bubbles, and the fix is a flush. Match crackling, screeching, humming, or banging to its cause and know when to replace.
Keywords: water heater maintenance, home maintenance, plumbing, appliance repair

Title: Dishwasher smell? The filter has to come out by hand
Description: An empty run won't clean the filter, door gaskets, or tub floor where the smell lives. Clean those by hand, then run a hot cycle with cleaner. Schedule inside.

Title: Refreeze fridge-thawed ground meat within 1–2 days
Description: Yes, if your fridge holds 40°F and you refreeze within 1–2 days (ground meat, poultry) or 3–5 days (steaks) of thawing. Cold-water or microwave thaws: cook first.
Keywords: food safety, food storage, meat handling, kitchen habits, reducing food waste

Title: Jeans and sweaters every 3–4 wears, gym clothes every time
Description: Give worn-once clothes one airing hook and a wear count: jeans and sweaters every 3 to 4 wears, sweaty polyester after each. Garment table inside.
